eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_table.lang_desc: long wooden table.   based on the region semantics, the table is located below the sofa and to the right of the chair. please navigate to the table accordingly.
the long dining table located near the chair.
coffee table that is located near the sofa, armchair, blanket, side table, and pillow.
coffee table located near the fireplace, chest, mirror, sofa, carpet, and pillow.
white marble table located beside the candle and below the picture.
coffee table located beside the sofa, near the chest and blanket, and close to the pillow.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_oven.lang_desc: the gas range in the kitchen.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_cabinet.lang_desc: cabinet, which is a piece of furniture in a living room. it is located below the tray and to the right of the picture.
cabinet with a broken door. it is located on the left side of the desk and below the wardrobe.
cabinet with a checkered floor and a mirror on it.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_blanket.lang_desc: blanket with fur on it. it is located near the armchair and the carpet.
blanket that is located on the sofa next to the pillow.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_bed.lang_desc: bed that is located on the left side of the pillow.
the bed located to the left and slightly above the bedside cabinet. the bed is a king-sized bed. use the mirror as a reference, which is located to the right and slightly below the bed.
bed located beside the bedside table. the bed is positioned below the picture and above the carpet. it is a white metal bed with a blue and white striped comforter.
bed with a king-sized bed and a blue and white striped comforter. the bed is located near a picture and a pillow.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_desk.lang_desc: desk located in front of the cabinet. the desk is described as a white desk with a window in front of it.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_wardrobe.lang_desc: wardrobe with a broken door. start by locating the mirror, which is slightly below and to the right of the wardrobe. next to the mirror, you will find the hanger. the hanger extends horizontally until the right edge of the frame. on the left side of the frame, there is a cabinet. finally, the wardrobe is located above the cabinet and spans the entire width of the frame.

eF36g7L6Z9M.basis.glb_tv.lang_desc: tv mounted on the wall above the fireplace. look for the fireplace, which is located in the bottom center of your current view. from there, locate the wall above the fireplace and you will find the tv.
